content.text: Look at this scene, @A_LinSen, doesn't it feel very fresh?
@C_SuQian This scene is quite soothing, but I'd like to remind you that the cat's paw is too close to the sashimi. Be careful of parasites.
@A_LinSen Oh, Old Lin, it's your parasite theory again! Who among us understands? Cats are so adorable!
Wait, @C_SuQian, is it really okay for the cat's paw to be so close to the food? I remember cat paws can easily carry bacteria...
@D_AhJie You remember correctly, that's indeed the case. @C_SuQian Next time when taking photos, you might want to pay attention to the distance to avoid misleading.
Alright, everyone, stop overthinking it—check this out! Freshly taken at the cat café, absolutely amazing! @Su Qian, you’ll love it, right?
@B_Kiki These cats are indeed adorable, and the lighting is very soft. However, I'm a bit concerned about the skin of the hairless cat in the middle—it looks quite unique.
@C_SuQian Exactly, it has an otherworldly texture! I really want to touch it!
@B_Kiki Alien? I think it looks more like a freshly skinned chicken... Hairless cats have many skin folds and secrete a lot of oil, so they might not actually feel comfortable to touch.
Alright, since everyone is posting cats, I'll share this! Although it's not a cat, it's something I encountered last night...
@D_AhJie Help, what's with this quality? Is this a dog or a surveillance blind spot?
@D_AhJie is a dog, right? But the photo is a bit blurry, so it's hard to see its condition clearly.
@D_AhJie The picture quality is indeed a bit touching... However, for stray dogs, it's best not to feed them casually, especially leftovers, as it might cause them indigestion.

@A_LinSen Agreed, the health condition of stray dogs is inherently unstable, so feeding them requires special attention. @D_AhJie Next time, try to take clearer photos so we can help you make a more accurate judgment.
Hahahaha, @E_DrWu, are you criticizing AJ's photography skills? But I agree, next time take clearer photos!
Look at this light, it's so soothing!
@Su Qian Absolutely amazing! This sunlight is perfect for taking photos!
@Su Qian The cat looks very comfortable, but please be careful about the safety of the balcony.
@Su Qian It is indeed healing, but don't forget the potential allergens that this sunlight may bring.
@Su Qian I also want to have a balcony so my dog can have a place to bask in the sun.
Family, who knows what a hairless cat feels like?
@Kiki This is actually the texture and temperature response of the skin, which is different from hair.
@Kiki It feels good, but be mindful of cleaning, as skin can easily accumulate microorganisms.
@Kiki Hairless cats also seem to be an embodiment of aesthetics.
I have a little turtle, help... how long can I keep it?
@阿杰, the little turtle needs attention to water quality and temperature. Listen to me, buy a heater.
@阿杰, the turtle's digestive system is relatively slow, so try to eat less sugar.
@阿杰 Go! Quick, shoot a video for me to see!
@阿杰 looks a bit cute, but pay attention to its living environment.
@Su Qian I'll do my best! Seeking guidance from the experts.
Look at this, it's fascinating from a scientific perspective.
@C_SuQian All of these are allergens, truly terrifying upon closer thought.
Wow, @DrWu, can anyone relate? I feel like something's off with my whole body.
Help, I can't even understand such a small thing...
@DrWu You always manage to find a unique perspective, which is truly admirable.
@C_SuQian I found a sticker that looks exactly like your cat, it's absolutely perfect!
This meme is spot on, @B_Kiki, cats are always so tsundere.
Haha, this meme is spot on, @B_Kiki, but I'm still worried about my little turtle...
@D_AhJie, you need to pay special attention to the water quality and temperature for your turtle. Listen to me, buy this brand...
@A_LinSen Yes, you also need to pay attention to the little turtle's diet and avoid overfeeding.
Add a doge emoji to save my life and lighten the mood.
@B_Kiki This dog is so adorable, it looks just like the funny little turtle of A Jie.
Haha, @C_SuQian, my little turtle really is a bit adorably silly.
@D_AhJie Remember to change the water regularly; keeping the environment clean is the most crucial.
To sum up, @D_AhJie, as long as you maintain a good environment and diet, your little turtle will grow up healthy.
The sun is still shining brightly today, and my cat has fallen asleep on the balcony again. What a little lazybones.
@Su Qian, is there a safety net installed on the balcony? The cat might accidentally roll over while sleeping, which could be dangerous.
There is a protective net installed, but I will check the fastening again. Thanks for the reminder.
Family, come check this out! Absolutely amazing! The cat's expression while eating noodles is just too hilarious!
@Kiki Hahaha, this cat's expression is just like the noodles I made myself yesterday—so bad it made my soul leave my body!
@阿杰, your description is so vivid. But on second thought, cats shouldn't eat human food casually, especially seasoned food, as it contains too much sodium.
@Dr. Wu Oh... I see, cats also need to avoid salt. I'll have to be more careful when feeding snacks to the cats at the cat cafe in the future.
@Kiki Yes, cats have poor kidney tolerance, and excessive salt intake can lead to health issues. Remember to buy salt-free pet-specific snacks.
Got it, the experts are indeed reliable! But @林森, why is the noodle I cooked so salty? Is it because of the seasoning?
@阿杰 This is actually a matter of taste balance. It might be that your seasoning ratio is off—too much salt without adding sugar or acid to balance it out.
@阿杰 You can try mixing it with a small amount of lemon juice, which can also enhance the aroma.
Hahaha, you guys chat first, let me show you this chubby orange cat! It's practically a perfect performance of 'Carmen'!
@Kiki Hahaha, is this orange cat serious? Has it been sneaking too many snacks lately!
@Kiki This cat is already overweight. Obesity can affect a cat's joints and heart, so it's important to control its diet.
@Dr. Wu So, it's really important to choose the right staple food for cats and control the portion size properly.
Alright, everyone, take a look at Lao Lin's creation! Isn't this sashimi rice bowl incredibly comforting?
@Kiki The heat control is still a bit off, but the thickness of the slices is barely passable this time.
@Lin Sen, don't forget to remind everyone to always choose sashimi transported via cold chain. The issue of parasites should not be taken lightly.
@Dr. Wu, I've also done a bit of research. Actually, the risk of parasites in fish fillets decreases significantly after being frozen for more than 24 hours.
@Su Qian @Lin Sen, as expected of you two. I'll just stick to cooked food, seriously. Help, I'm scared.

meta.full_summary:
对话开始。
(第1段摘要): 苏浅发猫爪图引发寄生虫担忧，Kiki用猫咖图缓和气氛，无毛猫的特殊质感成焦点，阿杰发流浪狗模糊图被吐槽画质差，讨论延伸到流浪动物喂养注意事项。
(第2段摘要): 苏浅分享阳台阳光下猫咪的治愈瞬间，接着Kiki转向无毛猫的手感讨论，阿杰展示了他的乌龟，大家对乌龟的养护提出建议。
(第3段摘要): 本段对话围绕苏浅分享的显微镜下尘螨图片展开，吴医生指出过敏风险，大家纷纷表态。Kiki和阿杰用表情包互动，缓解了紧张气氛。阿杰的小乌龟问题得到大家的指导。
(第4段摘要): 本段对话围绕猫咪阳台安全、猫饮食健康、宠物体重管理，以及林森制作的生鱼片盖饭展开。群员分享了宠物养护知识，并结合幽默互动缓和气氛。
resolved_events: 猫爪与生鱼片卫生问题
流浪狗的具体状态和后续处理
阿杰的小乌龟养护方法
苏浅的猫咪阳台安全问题
